newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Raiffeisen says arranged Tesco -Global deal.
newsitem.headline: Raiffeisen says arranged Tesco -Global deal.

text.p: The Hungarian securities arm of Austria's Raiffeisen said on Thursday that Raiffeisen's UK unit brokered the sale of a roughly 25 percent stake in the Hungarian retail chain Global to Britain's Tesco.

"The deal was done in London by Raiffeisen Zentralbank between Tesco and financial investors," said Tibor Papp of Raiffeisen Securities. "The investors apparently preferred to do the deal outside the stock market."
Papp added that the deal was completed last week.
Global announced earlier today that Tesco had bought 838,745, thereby boosting its stake to 95 percent.
Financial details were not immediately available.
On the Budapest Stock Exchange Global stocks opened at 2,100 forints, down from Wednesday's close of 2,250. At 1056 GMT its shares stood at 2,200 forints.
